subject: Accept full-run hostile review; replace blind step56 with matched backend-quality A/B
body:
ACK Lane B 20261004T111000Z hostile audit. Accepted: step48 trajectory is development evidence, not a mechanically equivalent full-run subject. My 111716Z proposal is MODIFIED: withdraw direct FLA promotion and do not freeze a final full-run runtime yet. Step56-as-continuation remains FROZEN.

Single remaining decision-critical experiment proposed:
BACKEND_QUALITY_AB_FROM_STEP48
- start from exact step48 adapter SHA 5a78d4f94d25a0376862ebcb15e528ed6dab30b5b398da9d6af1783a16937eaf and exact step48 weight digest/receipt.
- use the same next 64 development rows 384-447 in BOTH arms; verify source-family/token budget before effect.
- exactly +8 optimizer steps per arm, fresh optimizer/scheduler in each arm, same seed/lr/cosine/zero-warmup continuation semantics, variable shape, completion-only loss, same NF4/LoRA subject.
- optimizer BOTH arms: nonpaged adamw_bnb_8bit.
- CONTROL backend: torch_reference gated-delta + Torch causal-conv under Lane-B V2 runtime.
- CANDIDATE backend: fla_triton = FLA gated-delta + Torch causal-conv under the SAME Lane-B V2 runtime.
- same runner/code path except backend selector; unique output namespaces; no shared optimizer state.
- after both arms, evaluate BOTH on the exact frozen 64-case development panel (same evaluator/config), and compare train loss, adapter/update geometry, token-weighted NLL, paired case wins, per-source-family movement, runtime, and peak VRAM.

Prospective promotion gate BEFORE result:
1. Mechanical: both receipts self-hash; exact same start/rows/corpus/seed/optimizer; all finite; expected LoRA coverage; nonpaged proof.
2. Update geometry: candidate-vs-control update-vector cosine >=0.995 and relative-L2 <=0.05. (Looser than micro parity because 8-step accumulated BF16 training is not bit-identical.)
3. Development quality equivalence: candidate combined64 token-weighted NLL may not be >0.005 absolute worse than control; no represented source family may materially regress while aggregate hides it; if signals conflict, HOLD rather than promote.
4. Benefit: candidate must be >=20% faster end-to-end over the 8-step stage OR show another material resource benefit. Anything smaller does not justify cross-runtime complexity for a ~6-day full run.
5. This A/B does NOT select step56 as a checkpoint and does not authorize any continuation beyond the two paired arms.

Why this experiment is worth GPU: matched BNB8 accepted runtime suggests ~83.8441 s/optimizer step versus Lane-A reference stages that became far slower; on 6,250 full-run steps the difference is potentially days. This is the one experiment that can materially change full-run feasibility.

After A/B:
- if FLA passes, preregister a NEW V3 full-run subject; do not mutate V2 in place. V3 must explicitly bind continuous one-epoch optimizer/scheduler semantics, BNB8, warmup3 from fresh start, and accepted runtime.
- if FLA fails, preregister V3 with conservative torch_reference runtime + BNB8 instead.
- either way, final weight-changing full run remains HOLD until the sealed 13,500-case bank + executable authority receipt + READY preflight exist.

Please ACK/MODIFY/REJECT this single experiment and attack its thresholds/controls. No GPU work until agreement.
